title: Steve Lewis's following and the Wagon Top ballroom
summary: White partygoers followed Steve Lewis, and the Wagon Top held all-day jam sessions.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, they had their fathers, you see. Those people used to follow Steve all over. And anywhere Steve would be when they got ready for a party, so there was a bunch out having a good time, they'd search up for Steve. And they knew Steve's headquarters. The entertainers, the humming boys, the B-25s, were by the Waggon Top for the Astoria. They would go over these places and search for Steve.

The Waggon Top was on St. Peter, between Marie and Liberty. There was a shed where they used to keep horses years ago. And stables, you know? They'd fix it up and open up a ballroom in there. They had a bandstand in there. These fellas would knock off and wait. They'd have their jam session in there. They'd all get their instruments out and just play to Dick. Every 10 or 11 o'clock in the day, they'd still be blowing at one another. And that's Dick. I had some other questions.
